newsitem.title: USA: Delta seeks revoke of Brazil frequencies.
newsitem.headline: Delta seeks revoke of Brazil frequencies.

text.p: Delta Air Lines said Wednesday it would file a petition with the U.S. Department of Transportation seeking to revoke an award of Brazil frequencies to Continental Airlines.
Delta said it will file the petition so it can initiate daily nonstop service between New York and Sao Paulo and Rio de Janeiro, Brazil.

The Department of Transportation's decision to award these Brazil frequencies to Continental was based on Continental's operating two DC-10 aircraft between Newark and Rio de Janeiro with evening departures from both cities, by a date no later than July 11, Delta said.
Delta said Continental has abandoned its proposed two-aircraft service.
Delta also said Continental has defaulted on its promised evening departure from Newark, and will fail to initiate the Newark-Rio de Janeiro service by the required July 11 start-up date.
Officials from Continental were not immediately available to comment.
